description: Memo.in_flight (types/emptiness.rs) is a HashSet<Descr> that only ever holds the current recursion path (depth at most 5 on the probes, never hit a cycle there). Each Descr::is_empty_memo does contains + insert(self.clone()) + remove: three structural hashes and a deep clone. Make it a stack compared in place with nothing constructed. The coinductive meaning (re-entering a descriptor in flight assumes it empty) must be unchanged; add a test that exercises a real cycle since the probes never hit one. Largest single step: about -7% on 00761 and 00765. Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/compile-cost-round-two.html (https://claude.ai/artifact/4T5Lime7pQxKbCiKJqaJ8x). Spike (base c768670cd; port by reading, not by applying): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/tables/stepC.diff. Acceptance: stdout (interp and run), canonical dump, activation key counts and job counts identical to the base binary on /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/p/distinct1.fz, f761.fz (--top 1 --top 2), f765.fz (--max-top 3), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/m/r6.fz, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/l/lit16.fz; release instructions retired re-measured on base and change binaries built the same way; full gate.
title: The emptiness memo is a stack of the descriptors on the current path
